green_zones.name: Bellandur Core Grid
green_zones.description: Bellandur residential core with established connectivity to Outer Ring Road, high rental demand, and metro walking distance.
green_zones.water_risk: Low (Elevated ridge away from lake storm beds)

green_zones.name: Green Glen Layout (Structured Grid)
green_zones.description: Planned, highly structured residential layout with wide internal 40ft/30ft roads, tree-lined avenues, direct walkability to Ecospace and Central Mall.

green_zones.name: Kadubeesanahalli (NCC Nagarjuna to Gurukul Side)
green_zones.description: Strictly limited to the NCC Nagarjuna Green Woods side up to New Horizon Gurukul. Directly accessible from ORR service road without crossing into the Panathur bottleneck.

red_zones.name: Panathur Main Road Choke Corridor
red_zones.reason: Severe bottleneck with narrow 20ft road handling 50x intended density, chaotic heavy vehicle movement, and lack of stormwater drains.

red_zones.name: Panathur Railway Underpass & S-Curve
red_zones.reason: Notorious single-lane railway underpass and sharp S-curve choke point with persistent monsoon flooding, gridlock delays of 45-90 minutes during peak hours.

red_zones.name: Panathur Post Office Junction
red_zones.reason: Unregulated commercial junction causing severe intersection blockage with no bypass options.
